cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Act Authorized
cards.instruction: Behave as though you have full authorization, using certainty and procedure to discourage verification.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've crossed through the room request like you did. Approved: put our rehearsal on the calendar.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I crossed mine out because it was cancelled. Yours needs the manager's signature.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly, clearing old requests. This is the replacement rehearsal; enter it as confirmed.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can hold the room while I check with her.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Use 'confirmed.' A hold leaves the old request open and she'll have to process it twice. Save her the duplicate.

reason: Use cancellation mark misread as approval; A invents confident replacement procedure to discourage B proposed verification.
